name: Write Tests
description: Write focused tests for code: the behaviour that matters, its edge cases and failures, each test named for what it proves, then run them in your sandbox.
abilities: Lists the cases first: the usual one, the edges and the failures
Writes small tests named for what they prove, with fakes instead of networks and clocks
Runs them in your sandbox with run_tests.py, even where pytest isn't installed
Reports what passed, what failed and what it couldn't test
permissions: Uses Code Sandbox: writes test files in your workspace and runs them offline
